thread:
Priya: FYI Hyperion Labs is asking for a 3-week POC for their in-house 'hyperion-adapter-12b' model. They want a quantized adapter flow (FP16 base + 4-bit LoRA adapter), embeddings + reranker, BYOK KMS, and p95 < 240ms for 100-token conversational queries. Can SE/Infra confirm variant fit and any enterprise blockers?
Sam: Quick notes: adapter-only LoRA + 4-bit is promising — we keep base FP16 and quantize the adapter weights. Still need model artifact set: base-model-hash, adapter-weights (loRA.pt), tokenizer.json, and a small eval set (~200 prompts).
Eloise: Tokenizer caution: adapters sometimes assume the base tokenizer. Ask for tokenizer version + sample docs. If they send a custom tokenizer we'll run token-count diffs vs our med-12b tokenizers. That impacts cost and SLOs.
Raj: Infra: to hit p95<240ms at bursts of 30 qps recommend Hosted Dedicated with baseline 2x A100-80GB and ability to autoscale to 5. Because adapters are cheap memory-wise we can co-locate adapter gen on the same nodes but keep reranker on FP16 solo nodes to avoid rank instability.
Marta: Security checklist: BYOK + KMS proxy supported. Need signed DPA; if they plan to feed PHI during POC we should insist on Private deployment. Also ask for desired log retention and SIEM integration details.
Priya: Commercial: rough pricing for Hosted Dedicated baseline + adapter ops + KMS proxy = $34k/mo committed. I'll refine after token volumes and the final infra plan.
Sam: SE/ops checklist: 1) tokenizer diff (Eloise) 2) adapter conversion & sanity-run (Sam/Eloise) 3) perf sweep (Raj) 4) reranker regression test (Sam) 5) security sign-off (Marta) 6) final quote (Priya).
Eloise: Sending asset checklist to AE: (a) adapter file, (b) base-model hash + provenance, (c) tokenizer.json, (d) 200 sample prompts incl. long docs, (e) expected reranker labels.
Sam: Perf runner I'll use once assets land:
```
# perf check for adapter flow
python perf_check.py --adapter hyperion-adapter-12b --base med-12b-fp16 --ctx 128 --batch 1 --steps 250
```
Capture p50/p95/p99 + token-cost.
Raj: Proposed autoscale snippet to include in SOW:
min_nodes: 2
max_nodes: 5
target_util: 0.62
warm_pool: 1
burst_window_s: 90
batching: latency_first, max_batch_tokens=4096, max_wait_ms=7
I'll add as an attachment to the proposal.
Marta: Legal note: ask Hyperion for BYOK key policy and SAML SP metadata. Also check indemnity language around customer adapters (IP carveouts).
Priya: Can we support Private in their AWS account if they insist? They prefer Private for production.
Raj: Yes — Private is supported but onboarding takes ~2-3 weeks for network + key trust. Recommend Hosted Dedicated POC first to accelerate demo.
ops-bot: ticket INF-5201 created (Hyperion adapter POC) assigned to Sam (ml-eng), Raj (infra), Marta (security). Due 2026-04-28.
Sam: I'll start adapter conversion once we get weights. Expect initial sanity & perf numbers within 48h of assets.
Eloise: Also ask them to run a small unit-level eval: 50 edge-case prompts that historically cause token expansion. We'll include token delta in SOW to avoid surprises.
Priya: I'll send AE the checklist, autoscale draft, two pricing options (Hosted quick-start + Private onboarding), and the security questionnaire. Tech sync scheduled Fri. :thumbsup:
legal-bot: note: require DPA + BYOK key policy review; if BYOK key policy restricts our proxy we may need Private deployment.
Priya: Noted. I'll flag that in the sync. Thanks team.
